summary: Master platform governance and trust and safety operations with practical tools, policy workflows, and reporting methods. Enquire now for 5 days.
lede: Digital platform safety operations use governance rules, decision rights, and review processes to guide content and abuse decisions. For professionals in platform operations, policy execution, safety review, and digital risk control, this course covers designing moderation workflows, handling escalations and appeals, and measuring outcomes through metrics and reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work in platform operations, policy execution, safety review, or digital risk control and need stronger practical command of governance and trust and safety operations.
outcomes: Escalation And Law Enforcement Workflow Navigation
Trust And Safety Governance Charter Design
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop capable of opening spreadsheets, documents, and dashboard examples. Familiarity with moderation processes, policy language, or operational reporting will help you contribute effectively to exercises involving queue metrics, policy matrices, and escalation playbooks.
